backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor with storage, authorization, and data models for exercises, blog posts, products, memberships, muscle groups, profiles, and config plus initial CRUD-style queries and mutations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing components, files, and tests supporting deployment of the app to the Internet Computer.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains generated summaries of numerous frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and config for quick reference.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Provides instructions for building and deploying the app to the Internet Computer and retrieving the live .icp0.io URL.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Walks users through configuring a custom domain for the deployed Internet Computer canister using GoDaddy or Cloudflare DNS.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind root styling file defining OKLCH-based design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and global base styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with all application routes and wraps the app in theme and toast providers.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: Button component that copies provided text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API or a fallback, showing success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin interface to add, edit, validate, and delete Amazon affiliate products using CRUD hooks.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin tool for manually creating, editing, publishing, previewing, and deleting blog posts with validation.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty placeholder file for future breathwork admin features.
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting exercises with muscle groups, equipment, media, and validation.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: UI for viewing and editing muscle group cards using a dialog form and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand section, quick navigation links, and social media icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive site header with centered branding, navigation links, music toggle, and admin-aware dashboard access.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps pages with a global header, footer, and routed content outlet.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button that creates a Stripe checkout session and redirects the user to purchase a membership.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for Internet Identity login, state management, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand-powered hook controlling an audio element for simple background music playback.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, membership data, and Stripe sessions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup and custom theme variables defining dark-mode colors and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an about page with hero imagery, a quote, and a detailed founder bio with visual sections and backgrounds.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Displays affiliate products from queries with a hero section, disclosure alert, and product grid including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows blog post previews with a hero section, quote overlay, membership/admin controls, and loading or grid display states.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders an individual blog post with hero info, membership lock handling, full or preview content, and navigation back to the blog.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides contact info, support emails, and quick navigation links within a styled contact landing page.
Admin-only dashboard providing tabbed management interfaces for exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and store items.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Guides users through connecting a custom domain to their deployed site, showing canister info and DNS setup instructions.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, quotes, and core principles promoting membership and access to the workout library.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with options to retry checkout or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Validates Stripe session status and shows success, failure, or invalid-session feedback with navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Showcases training programs with a featured program and allows users to trigger purchase toasts.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: Implements the user dashboard with authentication checks, profile setup flow, membership status display, and logout handling. Loads user profile and membership data and conditionally shows a setup dialog for new users.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Renders a collapsible workout library grouped by muscle groups with previews, membership gating, and fallback images/descriptions. Fetches exercise data and supports navigation and access control.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from URLs or storage. Supports both query-based and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations. Extends utility classes and sets project-wide styling settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing and pending feature requests, and state versioning for deployment workflow. Indicates a pending request to deploy the current build to a live .icp0.io canister.
